items.title: 지난주 증권사 CP·전단채 17조4천145억원 발행…금주 만기 3조4천944억

items.snippet: 이용철 법무부 장관 후보자가 8일 이재명 대통령 관련 사건에 대한 공소취소 논란과 관련해 “좀 정리해서 말씀드릴 생각”이라고 밝혔다. 전임 정성호 장관이 “불법적 절차로 기소됐다면 검찰(현 공소청)이 판단해야 할 문제”라며 법무부 장관의 공소취소 권한에 대해 선을 그은 바 있다. 6일 국회 본회의를 통과해 국무회의 의결을 앞둔 ‘조작수사·조작기소 진상규명 특검법’(조작기소 특검법)을 둘러싼 논란에는 “앞서 ‘선관위 특검법’도 여야가 (특검 파견 검사에 대한 수사권 부여에) 합의했는데, 왜 이 건에만 위헌을 얘기하나”라고 반박했다. ‘대장동의 숨은 설계자’라는 야권 공세에는 “대장동 사업에 대해서 아는 게 거의 없다”고 일축했다.● 이용철 “李와 굉장히 조심스럽게 친해” 이 후보자는 8일 동아일보와의 통화에서 이 대통령이 자신을 지명한 게 공소...

items.title: 靑, ‘조작기소 특검법 위헌소지 없다’ 판단… 380억 투입될듯
items.snippet: ‘조작수사·조작기소 진상규명 특검법’(조작기소 특검법)에 대해 여권 내부에서도 위헌 우려가 나오는 것과 관련해 청와대는 “법리적 문제가 없다”는 입장인 것으로 알려졌다. 정부는 이르면 17일 이재명 대통령 주재 국무회의에 조작기소 특검법을 상정해 의결할 것으로 보인다. 조작기소 특검에는 이재명 정부 들어 출범한 7번의 특검 중 가장 많은 380억5600만 원이 투입될 것으로 계산됐다. 여권 핵심 관계자는 8일 통화에서 “청와대는 조작기소 특검법이 위헌 소지가 없다고 판단했다”며 “법리적 검토를 끝낸 법안인데 우려할 것이 있느냐”고 말했다. 이어 더불어민주당 내부에서 나온 위헌 소지 등의 지적에 대해서도 “청와대는 소수 의견으로 보고 있다”고 했다. 정부 관계자는 “11일경 정부로 법안이 이송되면 법무부 등 소관 부처 검토를 거쳐 상정될 것”이...

items.title: 李 “정치인 칭찬하되 숭배말라” 또 강경파 직격
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 8일 “칭찬하되 찬양하지 말고, 지지하되 숭배하지 말라”고 밝혔다. 구체적인 대상을 지목하진 않았지만 이른바 ‘무극파’(무책임한 극단주의파)를 재차 겨냥했다는 해석이 나온다. 이 대통령은 이날 0시 30분경 X(옛 트위터)에 “정치인이나 지도적 인사들에게는 칭찬도 지지도 필요하지만, 그것이 종교적 찬양이나 숭배에 이르러서는 안 된다”며 이같이 말했다. 이어 “민주주의는 저절로 오지도 않고 저절로 지켜지지도 않는다”며 “살아 있는 이성으로 진실과 정의에 반응하는 시민들의 끊임없는 참여와 실천만이 민주주의를 만들고 지킨다”고 했다. 그러면서 “행동하지 않는 양심은 악의 편이라며 할 수 있는 게 없다면 담벼락에 고함이라도 지르라시던 김대중 대통령님 말씀이 떠오른다”며 “노무현 대통령께서도 깨어 있는 시민의 조직된 힘을 강조하셨다....

items.title: 시진핑 비서실장 만난 北 김성남… 김정은 정상회담 조율 가능성
items.snippet: 북한 내 중국통으로 꼽히는 김성남 노동당 국제비서 겸 국제부장이 닷새간의 방중을 통해 중국 최고위급 인사들과 잇달아 회동한 뒤 귀국했다. 김성남이 카운터파트인 류하이싱(劉海星) 중국 공산당 대외연락부장은 물론이고 중국 권력 서열 5위인 차이치(蔡奇) 중국 중앙정치국 상무위원과 중국 외교정책을 총괄하는 왕이(王毅) 외교부장을 두루 만난 것. 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 참석 의사를 밝힌 18일 중국 선전 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의를 열흘가량 앞둔 이번 방중을 두고 일각에선 김정은 북한 국무위원장의 방중과 시진핑(習近平) 중국 국가주석과의 회담을 사전 조율했을 가능성이 제기된다. 중간선거 참패로 트럼프 대통령이 김 위원장과의 대화 재개 등 외교 성과에 매달릴 것이라는 전망이 나오는 가운데 북한이 미국과의 대화를 염두에 두고 중국을...

items.title: 정부 “용산공원 주택공급, 장교숙소 등 우선 검토”
items.snippet: 정부가 서울 용산공원 내 주택 공급을 위해 옛 방위사업청과 군인아파트, 장교숙소 5단지 등 3곳을 우선 검토 대상으로 추린 것으로 확인됐다. 이미 개발돼 있어 녹지 훼손 우려가 적은 공원 외곽부터 공급 가능성을 살펴보겠다는 취지다. 다만 이를 위해서는 법 개정이 필요하고 서울시 등 지방자치단체의 반대도 넘어야 한다. 8일 국토교통부에 따르면 국토부는 9월 말 국무회의에서 이 같은 내용의 ‘용산 미군 반환부지 추진현황’을 보고했다. 보고 자료에는 공원 북쪽의 옛 방사청(9만6000㎡)과 군인아파트(4만8000㎡), 남동쪽의 장교숙소 5단지(5만2000㎡) 등 총 19만6000㎡ 규모를 우선 검토한다는 내용이 담겼다. 용산공원 본체 부지(약 300만 ㎡)의 6.5% 수준이다. 국토부는 이들 부지가 이미 주거·업무시설로 사용된 데다 공원 외곽에 있...

items.snippet: 위험물 안전점검이나 방재훈련 등 위험한 업무를 수행하다 순직한 일반직 공무원이 별도의 보훈심사 없이 국가유공자로 등록될 수 있도록 제도 개선이 추진된다. 인사혁신처에서 ‘위험직무순직’을 인정받고도 국가보훈부에서 다시 심사를 받아야 하는 중복 절차를 없애기로 한 것이다. 국가보훈부는 8일 이 같은 내용을 담은 ‘국가유공자 등 예우 및 지원에 관한 법률 시행령’ 개정안을 입법 예고했다고 밝혔다. 기존에는 일반직 공무원이 인사혁신처에서 위험직무순직 인정을 받아도 국가유공자로 등록되려면 보훈부 보훈심사위원회의 심의·의결을 다시 거쳐야 했다. 개정안이 시행되면 인사혁신처의 인정 결과에 따라 별도 보훈심사 없이 ‘순직공무원’으로 국가유공자 등록을 할 수 있게 된다. 순직공무원은 군인·경찰·소방공무원을 제외한 공무원 가운데 국민 보호 직무 중 사망한 사람...

items.title: 낚싯대 챔질할 때 동사는 pull? set? reel?
items.snippet: 뉴질랜드 북섬의 베이오브아일랜즈(Bay of Islands) 앞바다로 보트 낚시 투어를 나왔습니다. 난생처음 도전해 보는 바다 낚시입니다. 낚싯줄을 드리우고 설레는 마음으로 기다리는데, 갑자기 손끝에 톡톡 전해지는 미세한 진동이 느껴지며 낚싯대 끝 초릿대가 파르르 떨립니다. ‘지금 당장 낚싯대를 위로 팍 채야 하나? 아니면 물고기가 바늘을 완전히 삼켜 묵직해질 때까지 기다려야 하나?’ 심장은 쿵쾅거리는데 타이밍을 도무지 알 수가 없습니다. 옆의 노련한 현지 선원에게 “톡톡 건드리는 입질이 오는데, 정확히 언제 낚아채야 하나요?”라고 다급히 물으려는데 “When fish eat, when pull?” “Fish touch, upper power?” 같은 엉성한 표현만 입안을 맴돕니다.

items.snippet: 미국 중간선거 이후 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 규제 우려가 커지며 증시가 연이틀 급락하자 정부가 신용융자 담보비율 규제를 한시적으로 완화하는 등 진화에 나섰다. 정부는 대외 불확실성에 국내 증시가 과도하게 반응하고 있다며 지나치게 비관할 필요가 없다고 선을 그었다. 야당은 증시 호황이 ‘거품’이었다며 정부 책임론을 내세웠다. 6일 이형일 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관, 이억원 금융위원장, 이찬진 금융감독원장, 권민수 한국은행 부총재는 긴급 시장상황점검회의를 열고 주식시장 변동성 확대에 따른 대응 방향을 논의했다. 정부는 9일부터 신용융자에 대한 증권사의 담보비율(140%) 유지 의무를 3개월간 면제하기로 했다. 신용융자는 투자자가 증권사에서 자금을 빌려 주식을 사는 거래다. 예를 들어 투자자가 자기 돈 40만 원에 증권사에서 100만 원을 빌려...

items.snippet: 김종철 경찰청 차장(56·간부후보 45기·사진)이 6일 신임 경찰청장 후보자로 임명 제청됐다. 경찰청장은 12·3 비상계엄 이후 약 23개월간 직무대행 체제였다. 국가경찰위원회는 이날 오후 서울 서대문구에서 회의를 열고 김 차장에 대한 경찰청장 임명 제청 동의안을 의결했다. 윤호중 행정안전부 장관은 이어 정부서울청사 브리핑에서 김 차장을 이재명 대통령에게 임명 제청했다고 밝혔다. 윤 장관은 “형사사법 체계 개편과 경찰 개혁이라는 시대적 과제 수행을 위한 거시적 안목도 겸비하고 있다”고 제청 배경을 설명했다. 김 차장은 회의에 앞서 취재진과 만나 “엄중한 시기에 지명돼 막중한 책임감을 느낀다”고 했다. 회의 뒤 최우선 과제를 묻자 “이상 동기 범죄나 관계성 범죄로부터 국민이 피해를 당하는 일이 없도록 시스템과 현장 매뉴얼을 정비하는 게 급선무”...

items.snippet: 더불어민주당 주도로 6일 ‘조작수사·조작기소 진상규명 특검법’(조작기소 특검법)이 국회 본회의을 통과하면서 윤석열 정부 시절 검찰, 국가정보원 등이 처리한 주요 사건의 수사·기소 과정이 검증대에 올랐다. 개정 형사소송법이 시행되면서 검사의 직접 수사권은 폐지됐지만, 이번 특검에 파견되는 공소청 검사 최대 20명은 직접 수사할 수 있다. 이재명 대통령이 자신과 관련된 사건의 수사·기소 과정을 들여다볼 특검을 임명하는 방식과 수사 협조자의 형을 감경하거나 면제하는 조항을 두고도 논란이 일고 있다.● 공소청 검사, 특검 파견되면 직접수사공소청 검사는 이번 특검에 파견되면 직접 수사하거나 수사를 지휘할 수 있다. 지난달 2일부터 검사의 직접수사권은 원칙적으로 폐지됐지만, 특검법 부칙이 파견검사 등의 수사권과 지휘권에는 종전 형사소송법을 적용하도록 했...

items.title: 여권서도 특검법 우려… 前법무 정성호 “조작 규명 쉽지 않아”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령 사건 등을 겨냥한 ‘조작기소 특검법’이 6일 더불어민주당 주도로 국회 본회의를 통과한 가운데, 여권에서도 법안의 위헌 소지와 법리적 모순을 지적하는 목소리가 잇따랐다. 이재명 정부 초대 법무부 장관을 지낸 민주당 정성호 의원은 이날 특검 수사로 조작기소를 밝혀낼 수 있는지에 대해 “쉽지는 않다고 본다”며 “좀 더 숙의 과정이 필요하지 않았나”라고 말했다. 그는 장관 시절 관련 사건의 진상조사에서 입증에 어려움을 겪었던 점을 언급하며 “무리한 수사가 있었던 것은 확실한데 과연 그걸 갖고 조작이라고 할 수가 있느냐, 바로 연결 지을 수 있느냐는 게 쉽지 않았던 것”이라고 덧붙였다. 곽상언 의원은 통화에서 “법안이 발의되고 나면 최소한 국회 전문위원들이 지적한 것은 해소해야 하는 것 아니냐”고 했다. 곽 의원은 “특검법안의 수사대상...

items.title: 韓-동티모르 정상 “지식재산-기후변화 등 협력”
items.snippet: 이재명 대통령은 6일 조제 하무스오르타 동티모르 대통령과 정상회담을 갖고 “동티모르가 새로운 도약을 이뤄가는 여정에서도 대한민국은 언제나 좋은 친구이자 든든한 동반자가 될 것”이라고 했다. 이 대통령은 이날 오전 청와대에서 정상회담을 마친 뒤 공동 언론발표에서 “양국은 어두운 역사를 극복하고 독립을 이뤄냈고, 어려움 속에서도 민주주의를 지켜왔다는 점에서 서로 많이 닮아 있다”며 이같이 말했다. 동티모르 정상이 양자 회담을 위해 공식 방한한 건 2002년 양국이 수교한 후 처음이다. 두 정상은 지식재산·기후변화 협력과 함께 동티모르 경제·사회 발전을 지원하기 위한 개발 협력을 강화하기로 했다. 인도네시아가 동티모르를 식민 지배하던 시절 독립운동을 했던 하무스오르타 대통령은 1996년 비폭력 저항운동에 앞장선 공로로 노벨 평화상을 받았다. 김대중...

items.title: 신천지 조사 결과 본 친명 “심각한 상황”… 친청은 “3자 비밀 연합 근거 없어” 반박
items.snippet: 더불어민주당이 6일 ‘신천지 신도 집단 당원 가입 의혹’에 대한 당내 조사 결과를 의원 등에게 개별 열람 방식으로 공개했다. 자료를 확인한 친명(친이재명)계 의원들은 “전남광주와 전북 등에서 신천지 신도 가입이 심각한 상황이었다”며 집단 가입 정황을 지적했지만 친청(친정청래)계는 “반명(반이재명)·분열주의·신천지 3자 비밀 연합의 근거는 전혀 없었다”며 반발했다. 민주당은 이날부터 일주일 동안 당 소속 의원과 원외지역위원장을 대상으로 신천지 의혹에 대한 자체 조사 결과를 공개하기로 했다. 자료에는 지역별로 일반 당원 1만 명과 권리당원 8000명 규모의 신천지 신도 당원 가입 정황이 들어갔지만, 구체적인 입당 시기와 명단은 담겨 있지 않은 것으로 전해졌다. 친명계 조계원 의원은 자료 열람 후 기자들과 만나 “비공개 개별 열람은 잘한 선택”이라...

items.snippet: Applied Optoelectronics Inc (AOI) of Sugar Land, TX, USA (a designer and manufacturer of optical and hybrid fibre-coaxial networking products for AI data centers, cable TV and broadband fiber access networks) says that the Compensation Committee of its board of directors granted inducement awards for 1346 shares of common stock to three new employees, with a grant date of 2 November, pursuant to AOI’s 2023 Equity Ind...

items.title: SK하이닉스 양산 노하우 담은 트리니티팹…내년 10월 문 연다
items.snippet: 트리니티팹이 내년 5월 클린룸을 개방하고 10월부터 테스트베드를 본격 가동한다. SK하이닉스 전공정 양산라인과 유사한 300mm 웨이퍼 기반 실증 환경을 제공한다. 트리니티팹을 운영하는 재단법인 측은 국내 반도체 소재, 부품, 장비(소부장) 기업의 기술 개발과 제품 상용화를 지원할 계획이라고 밝혔다.6일 업계에 따르면 트리니티팹은 5월 장비 반입을 시작해 10월부터 실증 서비스를 제공할 예정이다. 총 37대 장비를 들여올 예정인데, 10월까지는 70%만 들여놓는다. 나머지 장비는 2031년까지 순차 도입한다.트리니티팹은 정부와 경기

items.title: 레디스, AI 에이전트 실서비스 운영에 필요한 메모리, 컨텍스트, 메시징 제공 위해 Redis Iris 확장
items.snippet: 샌프란시스코, 2026년 11월 6일 /PRNewswire/ -- 레디스(Redis)가 오늘 AI 에이전트용 실시간 컨텍스트 엔진 Redis Iris의 새로운 확장을 발표했다. Redis Iris는 이제 에이전트가 실제 환경에서 안정적으로 작동하는 데 필요한 메모리, 컨텍스트, 메시징을 제공하는 6가지 맞춤형 기능을 지원한다. items.title: 2년 공석이던 경찰청장에 김종철 직무대행
items.snippet: 이재명 정부 첫 경찰청장 후보자로 청장 직무대행을 맡아 온 김종철(56) 경찰청 차장이 6일 임명 제청됐다. 경찰청장은 조지호 전 청장이 12·3 비상계엄에 가담한 혐의로 2024년 12월 직무가 정지된 이후 2년 가까이 공석이었다. 신임 국세청장 후보자로는 안덕수(55) 서울지방국세청장이 지명됐다.

items.title: 李, 본인사건 수사 특검 ‘셀프 임명’ 할 수 있다
items.snippet: 더불어민주당 주도로 6일 국회 본회의를 통과한 ‘조작기소 특검법’에는 위헌·위법 소지가 있는 독소 조항이 여럿 담겨 논란이 일고 있다. 이번 특검법 수사 대상에는 대장동 개발 비리, 쌍방울 불법 대북 송금 사건 등 이재명 대통령이 기소돼 재판이 중단된 사건 8건이 포함돼 있고, 특검은 과거 검찰이 이 사건들을 수사하는 과정에서 위법이 있었는지 수사하게 된다. 법조계에선 “형사 사법 제도의 사유화” “대통령을 위해 법 질서를 무너뜨리겠다는 것”이라는 비판이 나왔다.

items.title: 선생님 부담 줄이려다…원장들은 ‘0세반 기피’
items.snippet: 정부가 어린이집 0세반 교사 1명당 아동 수를 3명에서 2명으로 줄이는 정책을 추진 중인 가운데, 이를 따르면 한 반당 보육료 수입이 매달 60만원가량 줄어드는 것으로 나타났다. 수요 증가에도 운영할수록 손해가 예상되는 구조 탓에 원장들이 0세반을 기피하는 현상까지 나타나고 있다.

items.title: 12월 법관회의, 이달 30일로 앞당겨… 대법원장 국조·탄핵 대응 방안 논의
items.snippet: 판사 회의체인 전국법관대표회의가 오는 30일 정기회의를 연다. 원래 다음 달 7일 열 예정이던 회의를 앞당긴 것이다. 여권이 조희대 대법원장에 대한 국회 국정조사 등 사법부 압박에 나서자, 판사들이 대응 방안을 논의하자고 요구한 데 따른 것이다. 법관대표회의는 6일 “정기회의를 앞당기는 방안에 대한 투표를 진행한 결과 2026년 하반기 정기회의 개최일을 이달 30일로 변경하기로 했다”고 밝혔다. 투표는 지난 4일 진행됐다.

items.title: 공소청, 강호동 농협중앙회장 구속영장 기각
items.snippet: 서울중앙지방공소청이 6일 경찰이 신청했던 강호동 농협중앙회장에 대한 구속영장을 기각했다.

items.title: 입동 하루 앞두고 기온 뚝
items.snippet: 6일 서울 종로구 경복궁에서 관광객들이 두꺼운 외투에 목도리를 한 차림으로 길을 걷고 있다. 절기상 입동(立冬)인 7일에는 찬 북서풍의 영향으로 전국의 기온이 크게 떨어질 전망이다. 7일 전국 최저기온은 영하 6도에서 영상 5도로 예상된다. 서울도 7일 최저기온이 영하 1도까지 내려가, 일부 지역에는 살얼음이 얼 수 있다. 입동에 서울 최저기온이 5도 밑으로 내려간 건 최근 10년간 세 차례에 불과했다. 작년 입동에는 최저 8.3도, 최고 19.9도로 포근했다.

items.title: “월세 부담 덜고 생활비 아끼고” 동거커플 31% 증가
items.snippet: 서울 마포구에 사는 나모(30)씨는 6년 전 취업에 성공했다. 나씨는 회사에 다니며 월급을 받기 시작했지만 월세와 생활비를 내고 나면 통장에 남는 돈은 얼마 되지 않았다고 한다. 나씨는 내 집 마련은커녕 결혼 자금을 모으기도 막막했다. 비슷한 시기에 취업한 여자 친구도 같은 고민을 하고 있었다.

items.title: “결혼 6년 만에 낳은 아이, 최고의 피로회복제”
items.snippet: “집돌이·집순이였던 저희 부부는 두 딸이 태어난 뒤 대구 명소를 찾아 산책하는 게 취미가 됐습니다. 일이 바빠 두 딸 모두 돌잔치를 못 해줬는데, 오늘이 우리 가족 최고의 돌잔치 날이네요.”(‘31초 우리가족 행복담기 영상제’ 대상 김태형씨)

items.title: 아무리 외롭다고 집착하나… 6070 스토킹범 늘고 있다
items.snippet: 지난 5일 서울 은평구에서 옛 연인을 살해한 60대 남성 길모씨는 최근 이웃들에게 외로움을 자주 호소했다고 주민들이 6일 전했다. 길씨는 약 6개월 전 피해자와 헤어진 뒤로 이웃에게 부쩍 말을 걸고 먹을 것을 나눠주기도 했다고 한다. 이웃들은 “길씨가 평소 조용한 편이었는데 연인과 헤어진 뒤로 말 동무를 찾는 것 같았다”고 했다. 범죄 전문가들은 이런 주변 진술을 종합할 때 노년기 사회적 고립이 연인에 대한 집착으로 이어져 강력 범죄를 낳았을 가능성을 분석할 필요가 있다고 말한다.

items.title: 대구 달성군 출생아 수, 전국 82개 군 중에서 10년 연속 1위
items.snippet: 지난해 대구 달성군에서 태어난 아이는 1508명으로 전국 82개 군(郡) 가운데 가장 많았다. 2016년부터 10년 연속 1위다. 올해 1~9월 출생아도 1265명으로 지난해 같은 기간(1132명)보다 133명(11.7%) 늘었다. 지난해 합계출산율(여성 1명이 평생 낳을 것으로 예상되는 평균 출생아 수)은 1.02명으로 전국 평균(0.8명)을 웃돌았다. 달성군은 일자리, 주거, 보육 삼박자를 갖춘 곳이다. 달성군 현풍읍과 유가읍에는 첨단산업도시 대구테크노폴리스가 조성됐다. HD현대로보틱스 등 기업과 대구경북과학기술원(DGIST)이 들어서 있다. 근처에는 대구국가산업단지도 있다. 일자리가 생기고 아파트 단지가 들어서면서 젊은 부부가 모여들었다. 달성군 인구는 1995년 대구시 편입 당시 11만3000명에서 지난해 26만3000명으로 두 배 넘...

items.snippet: 지난달 13일 오후 인천 남동구의 한 상가 푸드코트에서 식사를 하던 시민 100여 명은 순식간에 지옥을 경험했다. 양손에 흉기를 묶은 최충락(59)이 식사 중이던 이들을 무차별적으로 공격했기 때문이다. 8명이 다쳤고, 중태에 빠진 한 여성은 아직 깨어나지 못하고 있는 것으로 전해졌다.

items.title: 이혼 소장만으론 부족해? 고소장까지 내는 요즘 부부들
items.snippet: 가정법원 판사로 일한 적이 있어서인지 이혼 사건을 자주 맡는 편이다. 이혼 상담을 하다 형사법 이야기를 하는 일이 늘었다. 배우자 명의 계좌에서 1년치 생활비를 미리 빼놓으면 절도가 되는지, 배우자 휴대폰에서 증거를 채집하면 처벌되는지 묻는다. 과거에는 간통죄 고소를 빼면 이혼 소송 중에 배우자를 형사고소하는 일이 드물었다. 배우자에게 폭행을 당한 경우조차 고소를 안 하는 경우가 훨씬 많았고 고소를 해도 경찰이 수사를 꺼렸다. 흥신소를 통해 미행하며 몰래 사진을 찍거나 모텔 문을 따고 들어가는 일을 두고도 범죄라는 인식이 희미했다.

items.title: 대기업 다니던 50대 김 부장, 이제 9급 공무원입니다
items.snippet: “연금이 큰 이유였죠.” 9급 공무원 시험에 합격해 다음 주 경북도청으로 출근 예정인 김씨는 1976년생이다. 올해 쉰 살, 중소기업에 다니며 외벌이로 두 자녀를 키우던 김씨가 올해 초 ‘공시생’으로 변신하게 된 건 고용 환경 및 공무원 연금 등의 향후 안정성 때문이었다. 그는 “노안까지 온 나이에 이게 무슨 고생인가 싶었지만, 정년 연장 논의도 있고, 갈아타려면 지금이 마지막 타이밍이라고 생각했다”며 “체력 부담이 있으니 한 번에 끝내려고 바짝 집중했다”고 했다. 퇴근 후 매일 새벽 2~3시까지 집에서 인터넷 강의를 들으며 독학했다. 그렇게 도전에 나선 50대, 지난 9월 발표된 경북도 지방공무원 전체 합격자 중 23명이었다.

items.title: 우리에게 발라드란 무엇인가
items.snippet: “제가 음악을 할 수 있게 응원해 주시고 챙겨주신 마음들 덕분에 요즘 사랑이라는 감정을 많이 느끼고 있었는데요. 이 곡에도 그런 표현이 있더라고요. ‘나의 사랑은 함께 숨 쉬는 자유’라는 가사를 좋아하는데 꼭 특별한 걸 해주지 않아도 함께 숨 쉬면서 같이 있어 주는 게 사랑이라고 생각해요.”

items.title: “응애, 이번 생은 인도 농부래”… 인생 뽑기에 빠지다
items.snippet: 태어난 곳은 부르키나파소의 농촌 마을. 가난한 집안에서 자라 학교 대신 농장에서 일했다. 끼니를 거르는 날이 잦았고, 열다섯에 결혼해 두 아이를 낳았다. 그러나 남편의 폭력에 시달리다 이혼했다. 이후 이미 아내가 있는 남자와 재혼해 셋째 아이를 낳았다. 마흔둘에는 이웃 나라 코트디부아르로 이주했고, 손주 다섯 명을 봤다. 생의 마지막까지 농장 일꾼으로 일하다 말라리아로 세상을 떠났다. 향년 57세.

items.title: 실록 지킨 ‘이안길’, 단풍 내린 ‘소망이루길’… 비경 내장한 산으로
items.snippet: 전체 인구 10만531명(2026년 9월 기준)의 인구 감소 지역에 속한 소도시가 매년 단풍 절정 시기 즈음인 10월 말, 11월 초만 되면 수십 만명의 관광객으로 들썩인다. 전남광주통합특별시 장성군, 전북 순창군과 함께 내장산국립공원을 품고 있는 전북 정읍시 얘기다. 정읍시에 따르면 올해 내장산 단풍 절정 시기는 7~8일 무렵으로, 기상 이변이 없는 한 중순까지 만추의 운치를 만끽할 수 있을 것으로 예상하고 있다. 벌써 입동(立冬·11월 7일)이라고 포기 마시라. 단풍 막차에 올라탈 가을의 최전선, 내장산이 있으니.

items.title: 실패에 관대하지 못한 사회엔 희망이 없다
items.snippet: 2008년 미국발 금융위기 당시 그 충격은 단순히 미국뿐 아니라 전 세계 다른 국가들에도 영향을 주었다. 그 국가들 중 하나가 미국과 특히 친밀한 관계에 있었던 영국이었다. 하지만 2008~2010년 미국에서 도산한 은행이 300개가 넘었던 반면, 영국에서 같은 시기 도산한 은행은 5개에 불과했다. 이 숫자만 보면 금융기관의 위험한 투자 행위를 방관했던 미국 정부와 비교해서 금융기관에 대한 감독과 규제를 게을리하지 않은 영국 정부의 정책이 옳았다고 생각하기 쉽다.

items.title: Hybrid integration of a SESAM with a silicon nitride photonic integrated circuit
items.abstract: The realization of high-performance femtosecond lasers on photonic integrated circuits (PICs) requires robust, low-loss coupling between a saturable absorber and a photonic waveguide. In this work, we demonstrate the hybrid integration of a semiconductor saturable absorber mirror (SESAM) with a silicon nitride (SiN) PIC by micro-assembly. This micro-assembly strategy transfers the non-linear functionality of the absorber onto the PIC. We characterize the linear and non-linear performance of an unbonded SESAM and of a SESAM bonded to inverse-tapered SiN waveguides. At 1560~nm, the bonded device shows a waveguide-coupled modulation depth of 5.2\%, a maximum reflectivity of 37.2\%, and a saturation fluence of 47~\textmu J/cm$^2$. This work demonstrates that SESAMs can be integrated directly onto silicon nitride-based PIC platforms and provides a pathway towards fully integrated, self-starti...

items.title: Experimental demonstration of dual-polarization nonreciprocal thermal emission at moderate magnetic fields
items.abstract: Conventional thermal emitters obey Kirchhoff's law of thermal radiation, which requires emissivity and absorptivity to be equal at each wavelength, angle, and polarization. This in turn places a fundamental limit on a range of radiative energy technologies as well as heat transfer. This constraint can however be overcome using magneto-optic semiconductors, which break Lorentz reciprocity under an applied magnetic field. However, in most prior experimental demonstrations, nonreciprocity has been restricted to TM polarization, since the electric field of TE-polarized light is parallel to the applied magnetic field. items.title: Asymptotic-Preserving Tensor Neural Networks for 3D High-Field Kinetic Equations with Applications to Uncertainty Quantification
items.abstract: Kinetic equations in the high-field regime describe particle transport dominated by electric-field acceleration and collisional relaxation. These equations are widely used in simulations of plasmas and semiconductor devices. Typical models include the Vlasov--Poisson--Fokker--Planck (VPFP) and Boltzmann--Poisson systems. Their high dimensionality and multiscale nature pose two of the major challenges to accurate and efficient numerical solution. To address these challenges, we propose an asymptotic-preserving tensor neural network (APTNN) method. Specifically, to reduce high-dimensional computational costs and memory requirements, we adopt the canonical polyadic (CP) decomposition structure of TNNs to approximate their solutions. items.title: Near-Quantum-Limited Readout for the Princeton Axion Search using a sub-GHz Kinetic Inductance Traveling Wave Parametric Amplifier
items.abstract: Parametric amplifiers are a workhorse for near-quantum-limited measurements above 1 GHz. However, amplifier development has been more limited below 1 GHz. We present a kinetic inductance traveling-wave parametric amplifier (KI-TWPA) operating over 300-700 MHz, with gain exceeding 30 dB and pump powers of a few hundred nanowatts. items.title: A Design Rule for Passive Reconfigurable Microwave Devices
items.abstract: Every reconfigurable microwave device places a tuning element - a varactor, a diode, transistor, microelectromechanical or phase-change switch, a ferroelectric or liquid-crystal load - inside a fixed passive network. The network can make a small change of the element produce a large change of the response, and design practice often credits it with the device's tuning capability. This paper shows that a fixed, linear, passive network cannot add to that capability. Each tuning element carries a tuning budget, a dimensionless length computed from its own impedance trajectory, and a fixed passive network can transmit that budget or lose part of it, never enlarge it. items.title: Electrostatics of Chern junctions in a magnetic field
items.abstract: Electrostatic control is central to the operation of semiconductor junctions made from conventional materials. Here, we theoretically investigate the electrostatic properties of lateral junctions between two-dimensional (2D) Chern semiconductors in a perpendicular magnetic field. The spectral asymmetry of a Chern semiconductor acts as a magnetic-field-induced effective dopant density that is dependent on the Chern number. As a consequence, two regions with different Chern numbers acquire different chemical potentials at charge neutrality, leading to a built-in potential of topological origin across the junction. Using this built-in potential as a boundary condition, we solve the 2D Poisson equation to obtain the electric potential and charge density profiles, as well as the capacitance, of Chern semiconductor junctions. items.title: Atomic-Scale Phonon Engineering for Enhanced Thermal Transport in Wafer-Scale-Bonded $β$-Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$/SiC Heterostructures
items.abstract: Bonding semiconductors to substrates with high thermal conductivity is a promising way to solve the heat-dissipation problem of materials that transport heat poorly, and it avoids the lattice-matching constraints of conventional epitaxy. However, the lattice mismatch remains, leaving the two materials with mismatched phonon states, while poor interface quality scatters phonons even more. Together, these effects block phonon transport across the bonded interface and make interfacial thermal resistance a critical bottleneck, calling for careful interface engineering. Here, $β$-Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$/SiC serves as a model system for a phonon-bridging strategy. A nanoscale crystalline Si interlayer is designed and fabricated by wafer bonding to bridge the mismatched phonon states of $β$-Ga$_{2}$O$_{3}$ and SiC. Spatially resolved electron energy-loss spectroscopy and molecular dynamics simulations...

items.title: Time-resolved infrared spectroscopy with entangled photons and visible-light detection
items.abstract: Time-resolved infrared (TR-IR) spectroscopy reveals molecular structural changes and charge-carrier dynamics on their intrinsic timescales, in photosynthesis, catalysis and optoelectronic materials, but requires complex sources of ultrashort infrared pulses, cryogenically cooled detectors to overcome thermal background, and intense probes that can perturb the sample. Quantum infrared spectroscopy avoids these constraints: harnessing quantum interference between the generation processes of frequency-entangled photon pairs, it reads out the infrared response of a sample by detecting only the visible partner photon, for which efficient detectors exist. To date, it has been limited to steady-state measurements. Here we demonstrate its ultrafast, time-resolved form with a picosecond visible pump pulse and a silicon detector. Each visible pulse generates photon pairs within a picosecond window...

items.title: Generative Modeling for Cascading Extremes via Autoregressive Transformers
items.abstract: Extreme events often occur sequentially, from earthquake-tsunami cascades to successive extreme losses in financial markets. We introduce an extremal token representation that encodes multivariate observations as a categorical sequence. A quiet token records the absence of threshold exceedances; otherwise, the token identifies the exceeding component with the largest marginal probability-scale score. The representation is invariant to componentwise strictly increasing transformations. It preserves the identity and temporal ordering of dominant exceedances but discards their magnitudes and the identities of nondominant simultaneous exceedances. A decoder-only transformer estimates the history-dependent next-token kernel on this representation, and recursive sampling generates future token sequences from the induced joint predictive law. items.title: DefectSkills: Guiding AI agents through first-principles calculations for point defects in semiconductors and insulators
items.abstract: First-principles defect calculations can now be performed autonomously by AI agents, enabled by established computational methods and open-source Python toolkits. However, reliable and repeatable defect calculations require clear scientific and technical guidance that helps agents resolve ambiguities and avoid errors in calculation setup, execution, postprocessing, and analysis. Here, we present DefectSkills, a set of structured prompts that provides human-in-the-loop guidance to AI agents performing first-principles calculations of point defects in semiconductors and insulators using the Vienna Ab initio Simulation Package (VASP). The prompts encode human expertise and guide agents through unit-cell relaxation, electronic-structure and dielectric calculations, phase-stability and chemical-potential analysis, charged-defect supercell generation and calculations, finite-size corrections,...

items.title: Optical Ceiling on Polaron Mobility in Disordered Molecular Semiconductors: Lessons from Eumelanin
items.abstract: Polaron hopping in disordered molecular semiconductors such as eumelanin is set by energetic disorder $σ$ and reorganization energy $λ$. We show that the reduced polaron absorption band encodes this transport problem. Its value at zero energy fixes the mean hop rate, which bounds the mobility in any dimension. For Gaussian disorder and classical vibrations its centroid is $E_\mathrm{op}=λ+(1-c)σ^2/k_BT$, its variance obeys the Hush relation, and the bound is the Marcus rate at $λ\to E_\mathrm{op}$; a 1D lower bound vanishes at $k_BT^*=(1-c)σ^2/λ$, read from optics.

items.title: Generalized Lorentz Framework for Active Semiconductor Quantum Surface Plasmonics
items.abstract: Nanostructured semiconductors provide an actively tunable platform for light-matter interactions across a broad spectral range. As feature sizes shrink to the deep nanoscale (~10 nm scale), nonclassical carrier dynamics and surface plasmonic responses become prominent, creating substantial challenges for a rigorous and efficient theoretical treatment. Here we develop a generalized Lorentz framework for quantum surface plasmonics in nanostructured semiconductors with arbitrary energymomentum dispersion relations. The framework enables efficient quantitative treatment of carrier nonlocality, carrier surface accumulation and depletion, and nonlocal damping in three-dimensional semiconductor nanostructures, under electrical tuning and across a wide range of doping densities. items.title: A RISC-V Simulator for the Tenstorrent Tensix Architecture
items.abstract: RISC-V based AI accelerators have become popular and not only for AI and ML, but also as vehicles for exploring HPC workloads more generally. Tenstorrent are one example, and whilst they document their Tensix architecture in detail and develop their software stack openly, running code has historically required a physical card, and their recently released simulator targets hardware equivalence rather than introspection. In this paper we present Wolfpine, a community developed RISC-V simulator for the Tensix architecture, supporting both the Wormhole and Blackhole generations and integrating seamlessly with the TT-Metal software stack. Constructed entirely from publicly available documentation, open source software and measurements on physical hardware, Wolfpine is written in pure Python for readability and ease of modification. An opt-in, provenance-tracked cost model adds timing fidelity...

items.title: Effect of compensation on magnetic ordering in (Ga,Mn)As
items.abstract: The real mechanism of ferromagnetism in III-V diluted magnetic semiconductors such as Ga$_{1-x}$Mn$_x$As is still debated. The experimental results point out the realization of appreciable ferromagnetism at filling of the impurity band close to one-half that can be expressed in terms of compensation degree. Based on our recent results on the existence of two competing mechanisms of pair indirect exchange (with ferro- and antiferro alignment of Mn $d$ shells), a theory of magnetic ordering in (Ga,Mn)As is presented. The molecular-field-like equation is derived in which the effective exchange constant contains all necessary information about material, including the Mn content, the compensation degree, the crystal coordination, and the parameters of two competing pair exchange interactions. items.title: Wavefront engineering with atomic Huygens' surfaces made simple
items.abstract: Atomic arrays provide a cooperative platform for light-mediated interactions in nonlocal metasurfaces which can operate in the quantum regime without nanofabricated optical elements or intrinsic material absorption. We present a minimal atomic implementation to harness wavefront engineering and create a near-ideal intrinsic atomic Huygens' surface. A simple bilayer square lattice with a two-atom unit cell, not limited to small lattice spacings, provides near-unity reflectionless transmission and a full $2π$ phase control of transmitted light without the localized site-dependent level shifts of previous proposals. items.title: Analytically Calibrated Upper L-Statistics for High-Dimensional Mean Change-Point Testing
items.abstract: This paper develops upper L-statistic methods for testing and localizing a high-dimensional mean change. At each candidate split, the proposed statistics rank the squared studentized CUSUM values across coordinates and aggregate either a fixed number or a fixed proportion of the largest entries. This construction connects max-type and sum-type procedures and provides sensitivity to a wide range of sparsity regimes. We establish asymptotic null distributions under an independent-component representation allowing weak cross-sectional dependence. The limiting laws are Poisson tangent processes for fixed ranks and Gaussian-process or Gumbel laws for proportional ranks. To improve finite-sample performance, we develop analytic calibrations for marginal variance estimation, cross-sectional dependence, extreme clustering, and skewness, and establish their first-order validity. items.title: Bezier-GP: Bezier-Surface-Based Gaussian Process for Chips-on-Wafer Warpage Modeling
items.abstract: As the semiconductor industry transitions to the post-Moore paradigm, wafer warpage has become a critical quality issue in advanced packaging; particularly for 3D stacking and high-bandwidth memory manufacturing where die-level deformation can affect bonding quality, interconnect reliability, and yield. However, direct high-throughput measurement of individual chip warpage remains difficult in mass-production environments, while existing wafer-level metrology systems routinely provide dense 3D shape data at the wafer scale. This paper proposes a Bezier-surface-based Gaussian Process---known as Bezier-GP---for chips-on-wafer warpage modeling. items.title: Temperature-Independent Logarithmic Current Slope in Interdiffusion-Broadened Silicon pn Junction toward Low-Power Thermometry
items.abstract: With the development of cryogenic technologies such as quantum computing, there is an increasing need for low-power cryogenic thermometers that minimize self-heating. Here, we report an anomalous temperature-independent logarithmic current slope, $d(\ln J)/dV$, in heavily doped silicon p$^{+}$n$^{+}$ junctions with significant dopant interdiffusion and highlight the advantages of our device as a low-power, cryogenic thermometer. Electrical characterizations from 2 to 420 K reveal that, at low forward bias, $d(\ln J)/dV$ remains nearly constant, which yields a voltage-temperature responsivity that is nearly independent of bias current. The observed transport cannot be fully understood with conventional diffusion or direct band-to-band tunneling. Instead, the results suggest the contribution of trap-assisted tunneling. items.title: Polariton tweezers
items.abstract: The non-invasive, deterministic manipulation of charge carriers remains a fundamental challenge in solid-state quantum technologies. Here, we demonstrate the concept of dynamic polariton tweezers capable of trapping and transporting electrons across a two-dimensional electron system via the long-range electrostatic potential of dipolar (d-) exciton-polaritons. By driving a semiconductor microcavity with a specifically engineered, non-collinear three-beam optical pump with TE-polarization, we synthesize a macroscopic polariton lattice with hexagonal symmetry. The spatially periodic field of this d-polariton condensate acts as a reconfigurable trapping landscape for the electrons. items.title: Cage-enforced i-wave altermagnetism in boron-carbon clathrates
items.abstract: The spin splitting of an altermagnet arises from a rotation that relates its two magnetic sublattices. In known cases it is fixed by the crystal structure. Here we show that guest-host frameworks separate the two roles. In the boron-carbon clathrates $M$B$_3$C$_3$ the ordered cage removes the translation between the two guest sites and enforces cubic $i$-wave altermagnetism, with six symmetry-enforced nodal planes, for any magnetic guest in the compensated state; strain retunes the class to $d$- or $g$-wave. We demonstrate the platform with GdB$_3$C$_3$: its compensated antiferromagnetic ground state is a narrow-gap semiconductor with spin splitting of 0.19 eV at the conduction-band edge, and its weakly pinned Néel vector switches the helicity-resolved optical response on and off according to the magnetic point group. items.title: Current-Confined Formation of a Buried Ge/Si Free Surface for Defect Filtering
items.abstract: Lattice-mismatched heteroepitaxy is limited by misfit dislocations, threading defects, and residual strain generated at buried interfaces. Here, we show that current-confined electrochemistry transforms the Ge/Si heterointerface into a laterally continuous nanometric free surface while preserving the Ge epilayer. A low-doped Ge layer on a conductive p-type Si substrate redirects anodization current toward the misfit-dislocation-rich interface. Numerical modelling including charge-transfer kinetics shows that this confinement arises from hole-limited charge transfer and, together with electrochemical calibration, defines a process window that combines interfacial current confinement with controlled Si porosification. items.abstract: Ab initio calculations were used to simulate the kinetics of attachment of new segments of the crystalline lattice (pyramids) at steps on the nonmetal-terminated surface of tetrahedral semiconductors: GaN, GaP, GaAs and GaSb. These surfaces are wurtzite gallium nitride, i.e. GaN(000-1) surface, zinc blende gallium phosphide, i.e. GaP(-1-1-1) gallium arsenide, GaAs(-1-1-1) and gallium antimonide GaSb(-1-1-1) surfaces. Diffusion species are gallium adatoms at high coverage or gallium adatoms connected with nonmetal atom creating stable pyramids. These pyramids arrive at the steps, and cannot be attached be directly because the Ga adatom at the pyramid base cannot be attached directly. Therefore they are incorporated into the step by additional nonmetal atoms glue atoms arriving from the vapor or detached from other segments of the surface terraces.

items.title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. VI. Surface diffusion on a nonmetal-terminated surface
items.abstract: Ab initio calculations were used to simulate surface diffusion of adsorbates on the nonmetal-terminated surface of tetrahedral semiconductors: GaN, GaP, GaAs and GaSb. These surfaces are wurtzite gallium nitride, i.e. GaN(000-1) surface, zinc blende gallium phosphide, i.e. GaP(-1-1-1) gallium arsenide, GaAs (-1-1-1) and gallium antimonide GaSb (-1-1-1) surfaces. The mixed coverage consists of Ga adatoms in the first layer with a nonmetal atom attached above them forming a triangular-based pyramid. The pyramidal structures are stable during surface jumps involving rotations around one of the basal Ga adatoms. Thus, the diffusion proceeds via rotation (pivot) of the pair of the other basal Ga adatoms around an immobile Ga adatom moving them into new, originally empty sites. items.title: Cross-Domain Joint-Embedding Pretraining For Heterogeneous Industrial Time Series
items.abstract: Industrial predictive maintenance and manufacturing tasks frequently contain abundant sensor measurements, but with limited labeled data. We investigate cross-domain self-supervised pretraining using joint-embedding predictive architecture for heterogeneous industrial time series (JEPA-HITS), which learns one encoder from various domains such as battery, semiconductor chemical mechanical planarization (CMP), computer numerical control (CNC) machining, and bearing while preserving dataset-specific temporal scales. We evaluate representation reuse on regression and classification problems under reduced-label downstream training, and leave-one-domain-out (LODO) pretraining. Compared with the same architecture initialized randomly, LODO pretraining reduces RMSE from 10.72 to 7.95 on battery remaining useful life (RUL), 4.34 to 3.89 on CMP, and 13.53 to 11.72 on tool wear regression, while im...

items.title: Gate-tunable superconductor-semiconductor coupling and its impact on zero-energy modes in PbTe-Pb nanowires
items.abstract: Superconductor-semiconductor coupling in hybrid nanowires plays a pivotal role in Majorana devices. Here, we demonstrate this tunable coupling in PbTe-Pb nanowires and its impact on the induced gap and zero-bias peaks (ZBPs). In the strong coupling regime, the device reveals a clean superconducting gap, where robust and non-robust ZBPs are observed in distinct magnetic field ranges. Conversely, increasing the gate voltage drives the system toward the weak coupling regime, where the gap becomes narrow and soft. Consequently, robust ZBPs disappear while non-robust ones persist. Our results establish a direct link between tunable coupling and robust ZBPs, providing guidelines on engineering Majorana zero modes and topological qubits.

items.title: Amplification of valley polarization in an hBN-separated MoSe2-WSe2 heterostructure
items.abstract: Transition metal dichalcogenide heterostructures host long-lived interlayer excitons in the +K and -K valleys that can encode long-lived valley polarization. We investigated the low-temperature valley polarization dynamics in an MoSe2-bilayer hBN-WSe2 heterostructure. The bilayer hBN spacer results in an interlayer exciton lifetime exceeding 2 μs and an anomalous valley polarization amplification effect. Our theoretical model shows that this amplification results from the long exciton lifetime and exciton-exciton interactions. This work sets the stage for long-lived interlayer excitons to be used in nonlinear valleytronic transistors and amplifiers.

items.title: Optical Detection of Coefficient of Thermal Expansion via Frequency Tracking at Cryogenic Temperatures
items.abstract: Accurate characterization of the coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE) in nanoscale thin films is critical for predicting residual stress and ensuring the reliability of modern micro-electromechanical systems and advanced semiconductor architectures. The primary limitation is that traditional methods depend on precise thickness measurements or are restricted to crystalline materials. In this work, we present an in-situ, non-destructive optical methodology to determine the CTE of suspended nanofilms by tracking the temperature-dependence of their vibrational frequency. This approach eliminates thickness measurements entirely and works for amorphous films where X-ray diffraction (XRD) fails. We experimentally validate this technique across a broad temperature range, evaluating membranes in their native microstructure state without requiring additional destructive patterning or complex sam...

items.title: Band Alignment of Grafted versus Directly Bonded Si/Ge Heterostructures
items.abstract: The electronic properties of semiconductor heterostructures are influenced by the local bonding and electrostatic environment at the heterointerface. Here, we investigate how the interface-formation mechanism modifies the band alignment of Si/Ge heterostructures by directly comparing Al2O3-mediated semiconductor grafting with direct bonding. Interface-sensitive X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy combined with Kraut analysis reveals type-I band alignment for both structures, but with different band offsets: the valence-band offset increases from ~0.08 eV for directly bonded Si/Ge to ~0.21 eV for grafted Si/Al2O3/Ge, accompanied by a corresponding reduction in the conduction-band offset. Raman spectroscopy further distinguishes the two interfacial configurations. The different core-level shifts and band offsets indicate that the electronic structure is sensitive to the interfacial bonding an...

items.title: Nondestructive 3D Metrology of Through-Glass Via Geometry and Internal Wall Texture Using Holotomography
items.abstract: Through-glass vias (TGVs) are increasingly important for semiconductor packaging, yet their internal geometry and wall texture remain difficult to characterize nondestructively. Here, we use holotomography (HT) to inspect the three-dimensional (3D) geometry and internal wall texture of intact, unfilled TGVs before metallization. HT reconstructs the refractive index (RI) distribution of the glass and via. Maps of RI and spatially filtered RI then localize the internal boundary. Geometric fitting quantifies via dimensions and taper, while spatial filtering separates slowly varying wall form from finer texture. The reconstructed surface supports volumetric visualization, dimensional measurements and spatial characterization of wall texture within one optical inspection workflow. These measurements reveal internal features inaccessible from surface views and provide quantitative descriptors...

items.title: Trapping photo-carriers in undoped gate-defined quantum dots using an on-chip microwave resonator for charge readout
items.abstract: Scaling up gate-defined quantum dot systems is hindered by the rapid growth in the number of control gates. To tackle this challenge, we propose a different approach where the quantum dots are created from optically generated charges trapped beneath accumulation gates. By shining an above-the-gap laser light onto an undoped GaAs substrate, we demonstrate that it is possible to create and separate electron-hole pairs to form quantum dots. For the charge readout, we use a superconducting coplanar waveguide resonator capacitively coupled to the quantum dots. With these elements, we demonstrate a working many-charge double quantum dot device comprised of only two plunger gates, one tunnel coupling gate and one sensing gate. items.title: Cryogenic performance of Silicon Photo-Multipliers at LN$_2$ temperature and at 3 K in the RES-NOVA cryostat
items.abstract: Silicon Photo-Multipliers (SiPMs) are semiconductor-based photodetectors that offer performance comparable to that of traditional Photo-Multiplier Tubes (PMTs), while providing several advantages, including low operating voltage, immunity to magnetic fields, compact size, and mechanical robustness. These features have led to their widespread adoption in scintillator-based detectors for both fundamental and applied physics. In recent years, there has been a growing interest in the detection of scintillation light at cryogenic temperatures in low-temperature experiments based on bolometric detectors, such as RES-NOVA and CUPID, as well as in emerging quantum applications. In the RES-NOVA experiment, radiopure PbWO$_4$ crystals are used to detect supernova neutrinos. The scintillation of PbWO$_4$ can only be evaluated at cryogenic temperatures, as the scintillation light yield is negligible...

items.title: Self-driven beta-radiation detection through a graphene/water/silicon heterostructure
items.abstract: Large-volume neutrino observatories, exemplified by IceCube, exploit Cherenkov light generated by neutrino-induced charged particles in Antarctic ice, highlighting the potential of water-based media for high-energy particle detection. In $β$-decay, a neutron converts into a proton via the weak interaction, emitting an electron and an electron antineutrino. The electron constitutes the beta radiation detected in this work, while the accompanying antineutrino motivates future extensions toward neutrino detection. Here we demonstrate a complementary electrical transduction strategy using a graphene/water/silicon heterostructure that generates reversible current transients under beta irradiation at zero applied bias. items.title: Energy Transfer and Strong Coupling in Plasmonic Systems
items.abstract: The coupling between plasmon resonances of metal nanostructures and electronic excitations of molecular/semiconductor systems is important in a number of applications, including surface enhanced spectroscopy, hot-electron catalysis, plasmon-induced resonance energy transfer and the creation of hybrid light-matter states. The past several decades has seen a large number of experimental studies of these effects, as well as the development of theory to explain the results. In this Perspectives article we use classical electromagnetic (EM) simulations to examine how the localized surface plasmon resonances (LSPRs) of metal nanoparticles and propagating surface plasmon polaritons (SPPs) in extended metal nanostructures (wires/plates/films) are affected by interactions with a molecular/semiconductor system. The classical EM simulations are complemented by a quantum model for plasmon-exciton co...

items.title: Cross-Scale Spatial Reasoning: A Learning-Centered Framework for Designing Immersive Learning Environments
items.abstract: Understanding complex scientific and engineering systems often requires learners to connect structures, processes, and behaviors across different spatial scales and levels of organization. Although research on spatial cognition, scale, multiple representations, and systems thinking has examined aspects of this challenge, these perspectives do not always provide explicit guidance for designing learning activities that require learners to integrate information across levels. Immersive technologies offer opportunities to explore otherwise inaccessible structures, coordinate representations, and investigate system behavior, but their educational value depends on the reasoning they support. This paper proposes Cross-Scale Spatial Reasoning (CSSR) as an integrative framework for understanding how learners establish and use spatial and structural relationships across scales or organizational le...

items.title: Reasoning Across Scales: Learning Challenges and Opportunities for Immersive Technologies in Chip Design Education
items.abstract: As demand for semiconductor talent grows, education must prepare learners for the complexity of modern chip design. Instruction typically relies on lectures, textbooks, software exercises, and limited laboratory experiences. Although foundational, these approaches offer limited support for understanding the spatial, multi-scale, and interconnected nature of chip design. Virtual reality (VR) can help learners visualize and interact with complex structures and processes, but its educational opportunities remain underexplored. We examined this gap through chip design curriculum analysis and semi-structured interviews with five participants representing instructional and learner perspectives. We characterized four learning demands: descriptive knowledge, procedural knowledge, relational and design-focused reasoning, and strategic decision-making. We identified challenges in connecting abstra...

items.title: Visualizing Anisotropic Charge Transport in CrSBr using Bias-Dependent Kelvin Probe Force Microscopy
items.abstract: Anisotropic semiconductors offer unique opportunities for next-generation electronics due to their direction-dependent transport. However, conventional electrical measurements provide only spatially averaged characteristics. Here, we employ bias-dependent Kelvin probe force microscopy (KPFM) to directly visualize the response of CrSBr under different electrical bias configurations. Spatially resolved KPFM maps reveal highly distinct, crystallographic-direction-dependent potential profiles. To elucidate this behavior, we employ anisotropic transport simulations that capture the charge transport and electric-field distributions in CrSBr. The close agreement between experiment and simulation provides a unified picture of anisotropic charge transport and bias-induced potential redistribution. Our experiments further reveal a boundary-associated redistribution of the transport field when bias...

items.title: Streaming Virtual Metrology via Lightweight Adaptation under Temporal Distribution Shifts
items.abstract: Virtual metrology (VM) aims to estimate costly or delayed metrology variables from heterogeneous sensor signals and in-line measurements, and it acts as a critical component of semiconductor manufacturing. While recent data-driven models have improved VM accuracy, most are trained in batch settings and assume stationary data distributions. In practice, however, production environments evolve continuously due to equipment degradation, process adjustments, and maintenance events, making conventional batch-trained VM models difficult to maintain under temporal distribution shifts. In this work, we propose GRAPE (Global Regression with Adaptive Prediction Enhancement), a practical online learning framework for VM in evolving wafer-processing environments. items.title: A Mixed-Precision CNN-LSTM Accelerator Featuring Long-Kernel Memory Reuse and Dynamic Quantization for Sleep Staging
items.abstract: This letter presents a mixed-precision CNN-LSTM accelerator for EEG-based sleep staging. To efficiently execute long temporal convolutions, a serpentine dataflow propagates activations between neighboring processing elements, reducing memory accesses by 6.2 times and 2.25 times compared with output- and weight-stationary dataflows, respectively. A hybrid quantization scheme applies runtime dynamic quantization to the LSTM and MLP layers and assigns mixed precision on a layer-by-layer basis, reducing model size by 4.16 times. Combined with a bit-flexible MAC architecture and channel-grouped memory scheduling, the accelerator supports INT2/4/8/16 inference. Fabricated in 65 nm CMOS, the accelerator consumes 0.40 mW and achieves a 258 times speedup over an iso-frequency 32b RISC-V processor. items.title: Effect of Rapid Thermal Annealing on the Superconductivity of ALD-Grown TiN thin films
items.abstract: Titanium nitride (TiN) is a promising superconducting material for scalable quantum technologies owing to its tunable kinetic inductance and compatibility with CMOS thin-film processing. However, the superconducting performance of atomic-layer-deposited TiN can be degraded by oxygen incorporation, off-stoichiometry, and crystallographic disorder. In this work, we investigate rapid thermal annealing (RTA) in high-purity nitrogen as a post-deposition strategy to improve polycrystalline TiN films grown by RF-biased plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition. Grazing-incidence X-ray diffraction reveals reduced peak broadening, a smaller lattice parameter, and a stronger (111) preferred orientation with increasing annealing temperature. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy depth profiling shows reduced oxygen-related bonding and a shift toward a Ti--N-dominated chemical environment after annealing....

items.title: Route-Aware EM Surrogate for Automated LC Matching Network Optimization
items.abstract: This paper proposes an open-source automated LC matching network optimization framework that combines schematic-level design optimization with electromagnetic (EM)-aware post-layout refinement. An ML-based surrogate predicts the frequency-dependent complex admittance of individual routes, enabling reuse across matching network topologies and physical layouts for the same technology node without retraining. These route models guide post-layout passive retuning to recover matching performance while preserving the layout footprint. Evaluated in a commercial 65nm CMOS technology, the surrogate achieves 1.94-4.91% mean absolute percentage error with respect to a full-wave electromagnetic solver, with no detected passivity violations. items.title: Field-resolved observation and quantification of the instantaneous Kerr response in semiconductors
items.abstract: The optical Kerr effect, whereby the refractive index of a material changes with light intensity, underpins nonlinear photonics and emerging mid-infrared technologies. Accurate determination of the nonlinear refractive index is therefore essential, yet conventional intensity-based techniques infer the nonlinear phase shift indirectly from changes in beam propagation or optical spectra. Moreover, methods such as the $z$-scan cannot resolve the temporal evolution of the nonlinear response, making it difficult to distinguish instantaneous Kerr nonlinearities from delayed contributions, including free-carrier effects. Here, we investigate the nonlinear optical response of germanium at $5 μ\mathrm{m}$ using field-resolved degenerate pump-probe spectroscopy. items.title: Full-Potential Korringa Kohn Rostoker Study of Structural and Mechanical Properties in SiGeSn Alloys
items.abstract: Accurate first-principles descriptions of open, covalently bonded crystal structures remain challenging within conventional Korringa--Kohn--Rostoker (KKR) approaches owing to the spherical approximations commonly employed for the effective crystal potential. Here, we systematically assess the recently developed full-potential KKR (KKR-FP) implementation in the open-source MuST package and demonstrate its applicability to diamond-structured group-IV semiconductors and SiGeSn alloys. Benchmark calculations for diamond-structured Si reveal substantial limitations of the conventional muffin-tin and atomic sphere approximations, whereas KKR-FP accurately reproduces the experimental equilibrium lattice parameter and bulk modulus, yielding 5.433 and 94.9 GPa. items.title: Dipolar Exciton Polarons in a van der Waals Homobilayer
items.abstract: Fermi polarons exemplify how many-body interactions give rise to emergent quasiparticles, providing a fundamental framework for understanding interacting quantum matter. In electron-doped two-dimensional semiconductors, exciton polarons offer optical access to Fermi-polaron physics and electrical tunability, yet achieving stronger and more controllable exciton-electron interactions remains a key challenge. Here, we realize dipolar exciton polarons in an electrically tunable van der Waals homobilayer, where interlayer excitons with spatially separated electrons and holes act as quantum impurities carrying permanent electric dipole moments. These dipolar polarons exhibit substantially enhanced exciton-electron interactions, with binding energies more than four times those of conventional intralayer exciton polarons. We further demonstrate that Fermi-sea layer polarization provides an addit...

items.title: Photonic Crystal Integrated Graphene-Silicon Schottky Diodes for Resonant Infrared Photodetection
items.abstract: Narrowband infrared (IR) photodetection has become a critical technology for the next generation of smart low-power photodetectors. In this work, we present a device based on a graphene-silicon Schottky junction with narrowband response in the short-wave IR (SWIR) regime. Integrating a photonic crystal (PhC) slab in the device enables a wavelength dependant tailoring of graphene absorption. The devices were characterized by photocurrent measurement, which was enhanced more than two orders of magnitude by the PhC integration. The sharp enhancements obtained can also be predicted by numerical simulation. This approach offers a highly scalable, tunable, CMOS-compatible architecture for narrowband IR photodetection, paving the way for next-generation, low-power IR sensors.

items.title: Magnetic scattering experiments with an ultrashort pulsed soft X-ray source using iLGADs
items.abstract: Inverse Low Gain Avalanche Diode (iLGAD) sensors developed at the Paul Scherrer Institute (PSI) in collaboration with the Fondazione Bruno Kessler (FBK) have demonstrated an excellent Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and Quantum Efficiency (QE) in the soft X-ray range. In the current batch, single-photon detection is achievable at 400 eV with an SNR > 5, while the QE surpasses 85 % at 250 eV. Combined with the high frame rates of CMOS readout ASIC, iLGAD sensors make the hybrid pixel detectors excellent candidates for time-resolved magnetic Small Angle X-ray Scattering (mSAXS) experiments in the soft X-ray energy range. In this contribution, we evaluated ILGAD sensors bump-bonded to 25 μm pitch charge-integrating MÖNCH chips at a laser-driven soft X-ray source. During the experiments, we measured energy-dispersed radiation between 600 eV and 1500 eV. These measurements were performed for the...

items.title: Y2CdX4 (X = S, Se, Te) Semiconductors: A First-Principles Study of Structural, Electronic, Optical, and Energy-Related Properties
items.abstract: We present a comprehensive density functional theory (DFT) investigation of the structural, mechanical, electronic, optical, thermoelectric, and bonding properties of Y2CdX4 (X = S, Se, Te) compounds for potential optoelectronic and energy-conversion applications. Structural optimization reveals a systematic expansion of the equilibrium lattice parameters from S to Te. The calculated bulk moduli decrease from 83 GPa for Y2CdS4 to 68 GPa for Y2CdSe4 and 54 GPa for Y2CdTe4, indicating progressive lattice softening. Electronic band-structure calculations predict indirect band gaps of 2.42, 2.08, and 1.71 eV for Y2CdS4, Y2CdSe4, and Y2CdTe4, respectively, with further narrowing upon inclusion of spin-orbit coupling. The calculated dielectric functions, refractive indices, absorption coefficients, reflectivity, optical conductivities, and electron energy-loss spectra reveal systematic changes...

items.title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. II. Adsorption of nonmetal atoms (N, P, As, and Sb) on Ga-terminated surfaces
items.abstract: Ab initio calculations were used to simulate the adsorption processes on Ga-terminated surfaces of tetrahedral semiconductors: GaN, GaP, GaAs and GaSb. The considered adsorbates are nonmetal species, i.e., nitrogen, phosphorus, arsenic, and antimony on wurtzite gallium nitride, i.e., GaN(0001) surfaces, zinc blende gallium phosphide, i.e., GaP(111), gallium arsenide, GaAs(111), and gallium antimonide, GaSb (111) surfaces. The cases investigated include single adsorbed nonmetal atoms and full coverage, i.e. theta=1 of these surfaces. The calculated results include the stable sites and the energies of the single adsorbed atoms: located at H3 sites at low coverage and in on-top positions at high coverage for GaP, GaAs and GaSb. At high nitrogen coverage, the N2 admolecules are formed, weakly attached to the surface. The calculated electronic properties of the single-adatom systems include t...

items.title: Universal model of the growth of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors on polar surfaces: pyramids and glue atoms. I. Clean surface properties
items.abstract: Ab initio calculations were used to elucidate the properties of the polar surfaces of III-V tetrahedral semiconductors, i.e., metal- and nonmetal-terminated. The systems considered were clean wurtzite gallium nitride (i.e. (0001) and (000-1) GaN surfaces), zinc blende gallium phosphide (i.e. (111) and (-1-1-1) GaP), gallium arsenide (i.e. (111) and (-1-1-1) GaAs), and (111) and (-1-1-1) GaSb surfaces. The calculated data include the crystallographic structure and the electronic states of the termination atoms on both sides, i.e. their positions, energies, and occupations. All nonmetal-terminated surfaces exhibit no reconstruction, and their broken-bond states are located in the vicinity of the valence band maxima (VBM), pinning the Fermi level. The Ga-terminated surface exhibited (4 x 4) reconstruction related to the division of termination atoms into sp3 and sp2 hybridized in proportion...

items.title: Quantifying Blinking Suppression and Probing Its Mechanism in PPD-Treated Single Quantum Dots
items.abstract: Colloidal semiconductor quantum dots (QDs) are highly promising materials for various applications, yet photoluminescence intermittency (blinking) remains a key obstacle to their practical use. While recent advances have enabled partial or complete suppression of this effect, both the degree of suppression and the mechanism by which it occurs are often difficult to establish. In the present work we analyse the blinking suppression of single CdSe/ZnS QDs after treatment with p-phenylenediamine (PPD), recently discovered by Yang et al. We revisit the blinking mechanism in this system and show that it is governed predominantly by the trapping mechanism, rather than by Auger ionization as previously proposed. For data analysis we apply a threshold-free two-dimensional criterion recently proposed by Podshivaylov and Frantsuzov. The criterion is based on the relative quantum yield estimator $\...

items.title: FrontierMat: Benchmarking Language Models at the Frontier of Materials R&D
items.abstract: To accelerate materials discovery, language models must be able to address problems at the research frontier. Yet textbook- and examination-derived benchmarks primarily assess established knowledge, leaving performance on frontier research problems largely untested. We introduce FrontierMat, a benchmark of 330 problems drawn from frontier academic and industrial research in fields including aerospace, semiconductors, embodied intelligence and nuclear fusion. Every problem is validated by leading experimentalists and industry experts in its field. Each problem presents a real study and asks the model to infer a withheld outcome or draw a conclusion from selected experimental evidence. Problems are annotated by functional domain, material system and the scale of the governing mechanism; 130 require cross-scale reasoning. The strongest general-purpose model scores only 53.7%, and on matched...

items.title: Unifying dynamical electron-electron and electron-phonon interactions from first principles
items.abstract: Electron-phonon interactions in materials with free carriers are dynamically screened by low-energy electronic excitations, yet first-principles calculations almost always treat this screening in the adiabatic approximation. A fully dynamical treatment of metals and doped semiconductors within time-dependent density functional perturbation theory (TDDFPT) is expensive and numerically delicate. Here, we introduce DFPT+A downfolding ("A" for active space), which starts from the static density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) response of a computationally convenient base system and adds the dynamical screening of a low-energy active space, described by Wannier functions. The required statically screened electron-electron interaction is computed using DFPT directly in the basis of Wannier-function pairs and truncated in a computationally efficient and systematically improvable way. The...

items.title: Evaluating Structural and SAT Attack Resilience in Cryptographic Dynamic Logic Locking via Keystream Capping
items.abstract: Untrusted third-party entities throughout the semiconductor supply chain expose proprietary hardware intellectual property to reverse engineering, piracy, and overproduction. While logic locking counters this threat by embedding key-dependent logic, conventional static key-gates remain vulnerable to both oracle-guided SAT attacks and structural removal attacks due to their time-invariant netlist signatures. Dynamic schemes such as STREAMLOCK mitigate oracle attacks by continuously masking signals with cryptographic keystream, achieving near 50\% Hamming distance output corruption under incorrect keys with low hardware overhead. However, confining key-gates to primary outputs leaves internal combinational cones vulnerable to single-tap structural bypasses. This work extends dynamic logic locking by distributing key-gates within internal paths prioritized via fault-propagation analysis. Th...

items.title: 10 kV $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ Sub-Bandgap Triggered Impurity Photoconductive Semiconductor Switches (i-PCSSs): Lessons for Optimal Design
items.abstract: $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ photoconductive semiconductor switches (PCSSs) are attractive for high-voltage operation, but above-bandgap triggering requires deep-ultraviolet excitation. Here, we investigate a 650-um-thick, 0.01% Fe-doped $β$-Ga$_2$O$_3$ impurity PCSS with a 5-mm lateral gap under continuous-wave (CW) 808-nm sub-bandgap excitation at biases up to 10 kV ( 20 kV cm^-1). The device exhibited clear sub-bandgap photoconductive switching. As the optical power density increased from 0.64 to 3.18 W cm^-2, the ON-state current increased progressively while the ON-state resistance decreased, consistent with enhanced defect-assisted photocarrier generation. A higher applied bias further strengthened the switching response through enhanced field-assisted carrier transport. The ON/OFF ratio increases with optical power density but exhibits a nonmonotonic bias dependence, reaching approximately 15-...

items.title: Complete Au-free Metallization Platform for UWBG Al$_{0.65}$Ga$_{0.35}$N channel MOS-HEMTs using Ti/Al/Ti Ohmic Contacts and Refractory TiN/Pt Gates
items.abstract: Au-free ohmic contacts and refractory gate stacks are critical for integrating ultra-wide-bandgap (UWBG) Al-rich AlGaN transistors with Si-CMOS technology. In this work, we demonstrate, to our knowledge, the first complete Au-free metallization platform for Al$_{0.65}$Ga$_{0.35}$N-channel MOS-HEMTs, combining electron-beam-evaporated and sputtered Ti/Al/Ti ohmic contacts with sputtered TiN and Pt gate metals. The Ti/Al/Ti contacts achieved a contact resistance of approximately 7.5--7.7 $Ω\cdot$mm while being fully Au-free. This contact resistance is achieved using a 600 $^\circ$C anneal, substantially below the 850--950 $^\circ$C typically required for Au-capped Ti/Al/X/Au contacts on Al-rich AlGaN, indicating a reduced thermal budget and improved compatibility with silicon-CMOS foundries. TiN gates deliver drain-current density up to 450 mA/mm at $V_{\mathrm{th}} = -13$ V, whereas Pt ga...

items.title: Efficient Simulation of Gate Leakage Currents in Ultra-scaled Transistors from First Principles
items.abstract: To ensure high electrostatic integrity in ultra-scaled field-effect transistors (FETs), thin gate dielectric layers are typically needed, potentially giving rise to (strong) leakage currents. Being able to model this effect is therefore crucial. Here, we show how gate leakage currents can be computed at the ab initio level in WS$_2$-hBN FETs by extending the well-established quantum transmitting boundary method (QTBM). Two main challenges are tackled: (i) the calculation of the open boundary conditions (OBCs) for the gate contacts and (ii) the solution of the resulting sparse linear system of equations A x = b where the matrix A possesses an unstructured sparsity pattern. We demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the state of the art and can be readily applied to simulate transistors with gate lengths exceeding 25 nm.

items.title: Electric field control of anisotropic spin traffic between spin-filtering and magnon-scattering in a layered antiferromagnet
items.abstract: Layered A-type antiferromagnetic (AFM) semiconductors offer a unique platform for spintronic devices by combining robust magnetism with gate-tunable semiconducting properties. We present a dual-gate field-effect transistor based on CrSBr, a layered A-type AFM with pronounced transport anisotropy and complex spin dynamics. Our device provides independent control over carrier density and displacement field. Systematic transport measurements reveal that the displacement field, rather than doping, predominantly governs the sign and magnitude of magnetoresistance ratio (MRR). We identify the origins of both negative and positive MRR components and connect them to interlayer and intralayer spin-dependent transport mechanisms. We interpret these findings with ab initio calculations and an effective spin-circuit model that reproduces the anisotropic magnetotransport. Our results identify the dis...

items.title: Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis: integrating reinforcement learning and conformal prediction for reliable wafer defect classification
items.abstract: Semiconductor manufacturing is a complex, multi-step process that requires both high precision and low operating costs. Therefore, detecting defects in a high-volume setting is an important component of wafer map analysis for reliable production. However, most state-of-the-art deep learning approaches require a full scan of the surface, which hinders the development of high-throughput inspection systems. To address this problem, we propose Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis (UFLD), a novel algorithm that employs reinforcement learning for adaptive measurement acquisition and provides a prediction uncertainty level after each step, stopping the process once sufficient information is obtained. Unlike existing methods that rely on ensemble models or auxiliary confidence estimation deep learning models, UFLD utilizes a more parameter-efficient conformal prediction framework to determi...

items.title: Cubic-Zn(1-x)Mn(x)Te optical modes across the phonon and phonon-polariton regimes
items.abstract: Alloying offers a convenient route to tune the physical properties of semiconductors, at the price, however, of local lattice/bond distortions needed to accommodate the lattice mismatch. Being nearly lattice-matched and moreover highly resistant to lattice and bond distortions thanks to a largely covalent bonding, cubic Zn(1-x)Mn(x)Te sets a benchmark to test the sensitivity of lattice vibrations to minimum lattice and bond distortions induced by alloying. We explore experimentally the two transverse optical regimes of cubic Zn(1-x)Mn(x)Te (x<0.7), with ab initio calculations in support: (1) the phonon-polariton regime at quasi-infinite (photon-like) wavelengths averaging over the alloy disorder, probed by forward-Raman scattering, and (2) the purely-mechanical phonon regime down to minimum wavelengths nearly matching the lattice constant zooming into the alloy disorder, achieved by inel...

items.title: Electronic liquid crystals and superconductivity from doping a moiré Mott insulator
items.abstract: Electronic liquid crystals, such as stripe phases and nematics, are self-organized states of matter with spontaneously broken rotational symmetry. They are expected to emerge in a doped Mott insulator as a compromise between short- and long-range Coulomb interactions, and are believed to be intimately connected to the emergence of high temperature superconductivity either as a competing order or an intertwined order. Moiré semiconductors provide a controllable platform to explore the relationship between stripe phases and superconductivity near a Mott insulator. Here we report the generic appearance of stripe phases in a doped moiré Mott insulator and the observation of a stripe to-superconductor quantum phase transition in twisted bilayer WSe2. The stripe phases were revealed by electrical transport studies as a thermodynamic phase transition from a high temperature isotropic phase to a...

items.title: Confinement Controlled Phase-Pure 2D Layered Perovskites for Band-Edge Engineering
items.abstract: Controlling the number n of connected octahedra layers in two-dimensional metal halide perovskites enables fine control of the semiconductor band gap that is highly advantageous for optoelectronic and light emission applications. Phase purity in terms of n is crucial towards narrow emission bands and the design of band structure alignment for charge carrier funneling. We present a simple and scalable synthesis method using cesium and butylammonium as A-cations to fabricate microcrystal powders of 2D lead bromide perovskites that results in samples with very high n-phase purity. The obtained microcrystals show a sharp onset in absorbance and single narrow emission peak in UV-blue spectral range, and we confirm their structure and composition with X-ray diffraction and energy dispersive spectroscopy. We show that we can tailor the spectral absorption of microcrystals samples by controlled...

items.title: SKFitter: Symmetry resolved Slater Koster tight-binding models from first principles for s, p, d and f electrons, spin orbit coupling and magnetism
items.abstract: Constructing accurate and physically interpretable tight binding (TB) Hamiltonians from first principles calculations remains challenging, particularly for materials exhibiting complex orbital hybridization, spin orbit coupling (SOC), and magnetic order. SKFitter is an open-source Python framework for constructing and optimizing symmetry resolved Slater Koster TB models directly from density functional theory (DFT) calculations performed using Quantum ESPRESSO or VASP. The framework supports s to f orbitals, incorporates on site SOC and site resolved magnetic exchange interactions, and accommodates both orthogonal and nonorthogonal basis. A central feature is the symmetry resolved parameterization of orbital manifolds, which allows independent two centre hopping integrals between symmetry allowed orbital groups and across distinct neighbour shells. SKFitter also identifies missing orbita...

items.title: PDE-based Bayesian Inverse Problems in All-at-once Framework
items.abstract: We propose a modern all-at-once framework for PDE-based Bayesian inversion by introducing the PDE residual as probabilistic information. In this framework, the PDE residual is treated as a soft constraint with a residual covariance and is directly incorporated into the likelihood function. The new hybrid likelihood function eliminates PDE solves, thus reducing expensive computational costs, while performing rigorous Bayesian inference. Theoretically, we establish the well-posedness of the posterior with uncertainty quantification, and numerically, we propose two efficiency inversion algorithms based on two posterior sampling methods. In particular, one algorithm is based on Metropolis-within-Gibbs MCMC method with a PDE-informed block- diagonal Gaussian prior, and the other is based on a joint sampling strategy. items.title: Growth and morphology of core-shell nanowires incorporating dissimilar hexagonal semiconductors: the case of InAs-ZnTe
items.abstract: Core-shell nanowires incorporating semiconductors from two groups, III-V for the core and II-VI for the shell, have been grown by molecular beam epitaxy in two dedicated chambers connected under ultra-high vacuum, and studied by electron microscopy. During the growth of the shell, the wurtzite structure of the core is replicated in the shell, without any creation of defects. This is true for a wide range of shell thickness, from about one monolayer, up to 25 nm thanks to the good lattice match between the InAs material of the core and the ZnTe material of the shell. While (1 100) m-facets and (11 20) a-facets coexist on the sidewalls of the core, during the growth of the ZnTe shell the size of the m-facets progressively increases at the expense of the a-facets which eventually disappear. items.title: I$_4$ complex acting as near-infrared emitter with a quantum memory in silicon
items.abstract: Silicon color centers emitting in the near infrared offer a route to spin--photon interfaces compatible with mature complementary metal--oxide--semiconductor fabrication. A key unresolved candidate is the X-line at 1039.7 meV in the photoluminescence (PL) spectrum, long attributed to a complex of four self-interstitials (I$_4$), yet whose microscopic structure and spin properties have remained controversial and uncharacterized at a predictive level. Using hybrid-functional (HSE06) density functional theory, we unambiguously establish the bare I$_4$ complex as the origin of the X-line: our calculations quantitatively reproduce the zero-phonon line, the complete phonon sideband structure---identifying the prominent secondary peaks as one- and two-phonon replicas of strongly coupled quasi-local modes---and the EPR hyperfine constants. items.title: Implementation and Validation of Mismatch-Tolerant High-Gain OTA with a Calibrated Negative Conductance Load
items.abstract: This paper presents the circuit-level implementation of a mismatch-tolerant high-gain operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) using automatic negative-conductance calibration in 65-nm CMOS. The technique enhances OTA gain by compensating for its finite output conductance using a cross-coupled transistor pair, with an on-chip calibration loop that eliminates the need for a replica circuit or external tuning. The calibration routine increases the gain by driving the steady state error of the OTA in a unity gain feedback loop toward zero. The implementation addresses practical challenges involving comparator offset, DAC design, and subtractor gain and offset. A 6-bit capacitive DAC (CDAC)-based comparator offset calibration scheme enables reliable detection of the sub-millivolt steady state error required for high OTA gain. items.title: OPERA: OPamp Design by an Expert-Taught Reasoning Agent, from Specifications to Layout
items.abstract: Analog flows from specifications to a signed-off layout rarely run without manual iteration. Recent large language model (LLM) agents size circuits with optimizer loops over the device dimensions and stop at the schematic. We present OPERA (OPamp design by an Expert-taught Reasoning Agent), in which a general-purpose LLM agent designs CMOS opamps from specifications to post-layout sign-off with open-source tools. First, the designer teaches the agent the gm/ID method: map the specifications to transconductances and minimum currents, choose gm/ID per device role from characterized lookup tables, and size from equations, leaving a few knobs to search and an explainable design. Second, the agent learns the gLayout framework and taught layout practice, and writes a reusable layout generator that closes the layout and extraction loop at designer-approved gates. items.title: Characterizing Performance Tradeoffs in Heterogeneous GPU-Wafer-Scale Accelerator Systems
items.abstract: As AI accelerator architectures become increasingly diverse, integrating different architectures into a unified system is emerging as a new heterogeneous computing paradigm. GPUs and WSEs differ substantially in compute, memory, and communication organization, creating both architectural complementarity and additional overheads, yet how to translate this heterogeneity into practical performance gains remains unclear. To address this gap, we propose a hierarchical benchmarking methodology to characterize GPU--WSE heterogeneous execution and the conditions for exploiting complementarity, together with an analytical performance model that identifies when heterogeneity becomes a bottleneck and when it yields system-level performance gains.

items.title: Coherent Optical Control of a Single Donor Electron Spin
items.abstract: Coherent spin--photon interfaces for scalable quantum networks require bright optical transitions, long-lived spin coherence, and complete coherent spin control. Donor spins in direct-bandgap semiconductors combine strong donor-bound exciton transitions with a potentially nuclear-spin-free environment. However, coherent control of an individual optically active donor spin has remained elusive. Here, we demonstrate coherent optical control of a single Cl donor electron spin in ZnSe. Resonant excitation reveals spin relaxation dynamics and measures spin coherence through coherent population trapping (CPT). Off-resonant ultrafast pulses are implemented to drive spin Rabi oscillations and demonstrate Ramsey interference. Multiple dark resonances in the CPT spectrum further reveal hyperfine coupling between the electron and the I=3/2 Cl nucleus. Together, these results demonstrate the first c...

items.title: Online Open-World Wafer Defect Discovery using Hyperdimensional Computing
items.abstract: Conventional wafer defect analysis relies on offline, closed-world classifiers that fail to detect novel, unseen defect signatures emerging during continuous semiconductor manufacturing. To address this, we propose WaferHDC, an online open-world wafer defect discovery framework based on hyperdimensional computing (HDC). The memory-centric architecture of WaferHDC enables rapid anomaly detection and grouping of recurring failures into compact hypervector representations. This allows the memory space to dynamically scale with new defect modes without retraining a static classifier or archiving entire raw wafer history. WaferHDC first models normal spatial distributions, then dynamically groups recurring failures into persistent defect memory without labels or predefined class counts. It outperforms the strongest online baseline by 13.3 p.p. in adjusted Rand index and 10.5 p.p. in normalize...

items.title: Residual AM and PM Noise of Selected X-Band Amplifiers
items.abstract: In microwave systems design, amplitude modulation (AM) noise is often ignored relative to phase modulation (PM) noise. However, in high-performance applications requiring ultra-low PM noise, AM noise becomes a critical limiting factor due to AM-to-PM conversion mechanisms. Because AM noise specifications are rarely, if ever, provided for commercial microwave components, this study characterizes the residual AM and PM noise of several 10 GHz amplifiers. We present performance data for various Heterojunction Bipolar Transistor (HBT) amplifier designs and demonstrate the noise reduction achieved through power-summed configurations. For example, a discrete-die GaAs HBT amplifier achieves residual PM noise below $-160$ dBrad$^2$/Hz and AM noise of approximately $-155$ dB/Hz at a 1 kHz offset in a quad power-summed configuration.
